text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it's an important racing outfit, after all.
I just have to give advice on a design
that brings out the material's shine to the fullest!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
The theme should be girlish, just like her...
No, maybe a cool pants style
would help her feel more sharp and focused?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Considering my personal color palette,
warm tones are a must, but I also want to incorporate my favorite color, blue, so...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, maybe I should roll up the sleeves to show the lining?
Though, that might look a bit too casual...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
North Flight earnestly compares the magazines,
trying to come up with her top design idea.
And so, the night wore on...
